children.characters: Your PAN. Your Aadhaar details from DigiLocker when you approve sharing; what DigiLocker shares can include your name, date of birth, gender, address and photo. We read them once to check them and keep only the few details listed below. We don't ask for photos or selfies.

children.name: To check that you are who you say you ar
children.characters: To check that you are who you say you are, which Renit asks before you rent some higher-value items or take bookings as an owner. We don't use this information for anything else.

children.name: Cashfree Payments India Private Limited
children.characters: Cashfree Payments India Private Limited checks your PAN and connects you to DigiLocker for us. They handle your details under their own privacy policy: [CASHFREE PRIVACY POLICY LINK]. A member of the Renit team reviews each case before it's approved, and can see your name, your PAN's last 4 digits and the few Aadhaar details listed below.

children.name: From your Aadhaar we keep only a few det
children.characters: From your Aadhaar we keep only a few details: your name, year of birth, state, pincode and the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar number. We keep them for up to 180 days after we decide, then delete them. We never keep a copy of your Aadhaar itself. We don't store your full PAN: we keep the last 4 digits and a scrambled code that helps us spot duplicates. We keep the result of your verification for as long as you have a Renit account.

children.name: Verification is optional, but without it
children.characters: Verification is optional, but without it you can't rent the items or take the bookings that need it. You can remove your verification data any time from your Profile, without deleting your account, and you can delete your Renit account from Profile, Personal details. Copies in our backups are cleared within 30 days after the 180 days. Questions about your data: support@simplyrenit.com.
